payload.outcome: Resolved 2026-09-26 with owner permission, via the Railway connector. Railway HTTP logs showed every delivery to /api/webhooks/railway on 2026-09-25 answered 401 and none arrived after 18:04 UTC. The stored webhook URL wrapped its token in angle brackets, but a test without the brackets was also refused, so the token itself did not match. The old secret could not be read (the connector returns variable names only), so a new 64-hex-character secret was set as RAILWAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET on the Database service in production (redeploy eb7131ed) and the same value put in the webhook URL (webhook 469b5a36, event list unchanged). Railway test-webhook then returned 200, delivered: true. Follow-up for a possible Doppler copy of the old value is tracked separately.
